nom: e11ement Hypochlorous Acid Spray for Skin

avis.texte: This is the second bottle I’ve ordered. It’s great for calming irritated skin, including the scalp, after the sun. A great tool to have in your medicine cabinet.
I will forever repurchase this. I use it before my skincare routines, after the gym, daily whenever I need a refresh.

I’m literally OBSESSED with this stuff. I’ve now purchased 3 times. A little bit goes a long way. It leaves no residue and is light as water. My skin feels clean without feeling taut. Love love love and highly recommend.
